unit: npm install -g pnpm@10 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && pnpm test:coverage --coverage.reporter=cobertura --coverage.reporter=text-summary && cp coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml coverage.xml
regression: npm install -g pnpm@10 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && pnpm test:perf
e2e: npm install -g pnpm@10 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && pnpm run test:portable
install: claude plugin marketplace add "$PWD" && claude plugin install ai-architect-mcp-spec@ai-architect-mcp-spec-marketplace && root="$(claude plugin list --json | jq -r '.[] | select(.id | startswith("ai-architect-mcp-spec@")) | .installPath')" && test -n "$root" && bash scripts/check-health-stdio.sh "$root"
